name: Omostrich
author: tim
description: Local Nostr signer and note composer for Omarchy. One bar chip to unlock your locally encrypted Nostr key, compose and post kind-1 notes, approve NIP-46 signing requests from other Nostr apps, and manage relays and authorized apps. Plus a compose-only hotkey overlay (SUPER + N). Not a feed or client; your private key never leaves the local vault.

barWidget.description: Nostr: compose a note, unlock/lock the signer, review NIP-46 approvals, manage relays.
